Source-reviewed orchestration. Nested semantics remain open; no runtime acceptance
claimed. This wrapper reads and prints; it does not persist turn/session testimony. The
curated-fact trust gate is not the same calculation as consensus confidence. Individual
take branches, firmware validation, claims/holds queries and native semantics remain
nested; empty answers can still return 0. Source review only; no Engine command executed.
